2609.17691.title: Accelerating Diffusion Sampling via Speculative Draft Trees
2609.17691.paper_summary: Speculative sampling accelerates diffusion model generation by drafting inexpensive candidate states and correcting them under a coupling that preserves the target distribution exactly, reducing the number of expensive target evaluations. Existing diffusion samplers, notably those based on reflection maximal coupling, are topologically constrained: their lookahead drafts form a chain graph, a single linear sequence, which inherently limits the acceptance rate per target evaluation. We connect speculative sampling in diffusion models to relative entropy coding (REC). This perspective shows the lookahead need not be linear and motivates our central contribution, draft trees, which enrich the candidates considered per round and lower the target function evaluations. We further adopt greedy rejection sampling, an REC algorithm, as the draft-target coupling, improving acceptance while guaranteeing exact target samples. Experiments across diverse target and draft models demonstrate up to 8.3% acceleration over the reflection coupling baseline in practical settings.
2609.17691.paper_summary_zh: 推測取樣透過草擬廉價候選狀態並在保持目標分佈的耦合下進行修正，加速了擴散模型的生成，從而減少了昂貴的目標評估次數。現有的擴散取樣器，特別是基於反射最大耦合的那些，受到拓撲的限制：它們的前瞻草擬形成一個鏈圖，一個單一的線性序列，這本質上限制了每次目標評估的接受率。我們將擴散模型中的推測取樣與相對熵編碼（REC）聯繫起來。這一觀點顯示前瞻不必是線性的，並激發了我們的核心貢獻，即草擬樹，這豐富了每輪考慮的候選者並降低了目標函數的評估。我們進一步採用了貪婪拒絕取樣，一種REC算法，作為草擬-目標耦合，改善了接受率，同時保證了精確的目標樣本。在各種目標和草擬模型上的實驗顯示，在實際環境中，相較於反射耦合基線，速度提高了最多8.3%。
